newsitem.title: USA: IDT IN $1.5 MLN DEAL WITH DAEWOO, NARAY.
newsitem.headline: IDT IN $1.5 MLN DEAL WITH DAEWOO, NARAY.

text.p: IDT Corp said Thursday it agreed with Daewoo Corp and Naray Mobile Telecom Inc to exclusively offer its Internet phone service called Net2Phone Direct in Korea in a deal valued at $1.5 million.
IDT said the deal involves the purchase of Net2Phone Direct servers and infrastructure, and setup and development.

Under the agreement, Daewoo will distribute IDT's Net2Phone Direct servers and software in Korea. Naray will provide IDT's Internet telephony services acting as the official operator and representative of IDT in Korea.
Daewoo already has an exclusive agreement to sell Net2Phone IDT's personal computer phone technology in Korea.
IDT said calls placed over Net2Phone Direct are converted from a standard telephone to the Internet's digital signal processing and transmitted through the Internet to telephone.
The company said the total cost of that call will be lower than traditional telephone costs because the call only travels a short distance on the circuit switch network.
IDT said it plans to launch Net2Phone Direct in the U.S. later this month, and it expects to launch in Italy and other international locations by the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 1998.
